verdict.rationale: 2FAS Auth is described as open-source, local-first with no public API for token generation, and pricing docs confirm it's free with no telemetry, consistent with fully offline TOTP generation without vendor account requirement. Community evidence questions cloud-sync/backup security but this concerns 2FAS Pass (password manager), not the core Auth TOTP generation flow. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that TOTP codes generate with device fully offline (airplane mode test), and explicit documentation stating no account/signup is ever required.
